required_visual_features: A scientific line chart with current or current density on the x axis.
Voltage is represented on the left y axis.
Power density or power is represented on the right y axis.
The chart uses two y axes or otherwise clearly maps voltage and power to separate value scales.
The voltage and power curves are drawn in distinguishable colors, not just black lines told apart by marker shape or line style.
negative_cues: Marker-only scatter chart without visible connecting lines - not currently extractable
Nyquist or impedance semicircle plot
bar chart
histogram
pie chart
SEM or microscopy image
process schematic
single-axis polarization curve without power axis
a chart whose x axis positions are category labels rather than numbers — use categorical_line_chart instead
a chart whose curves are not distinguishable by color (e.g. all-black curves told apart only by marker shape or line style) — not currently extractable
output_requirements: Set chart_family to dual_y_current_voltage_power or a close descriptive variant.
Return bottom, left, and right axis geometry and numeric tick labels when visible.
Return legend_items when series labels are visible.

For each legend item, set axis_binding_hint to left_y or right_y by matching the legend label's meaning (e.g. a voltage-like label) to the matching axis title. Leave axis_binding_hint null only when the voltage and power-density curves for the same condition are drawn in the exact same color and cannot be told apart from the legend alone.

required_visual_features: A scientific line chart with exactly one y axis (no second, right-side y axis with its own scale).
One or more distinguishable data series, told apart by curve/marker color.
Numeric tick labels on the x axis and the single y axis.
negative_cues: Marker-only scatter chart without visible connecting lines - not currently extractable
A chart with two differently-scaled y axes (left and right) — use one of the dual-y families instead
Nyquist or impedance semicircle plot without numeric axes suitable for digitization
bar chart
histogram
pie chart
SEM or microscopy image
process schematic
a chart whose x axis positions are category labels (sample names, material names, conditions) rather than numbers, even if points are connected by lines — use categorical_line_chart instead
a chart whose data series are all the same color and distinguished only by marker shape or line style, not color — not currently extractable
output_requirements: Return bottom and left axis geometry and numeric tick labels when visible.
Return legend_items when series labels are visible. Since there is only one y axis, set axis_binding_hint to left_y for every legend item (or null if unsure).

enabled_extraction_families.display_name: Line chart with a categorical (non-numeric) x axis
required_visual_features: A line chart with visible connecting lines (markers on lines are allowed) whose x axis positions are category labels — sample names, material names, conditions, or similar text — not numbers.
One or more distinguishable data series, told apart by curve/marker color.
negative_cues: Marker-only scatter chart without visible connecting lines - not currently extractable
A chart whose x axis is numeric (has a real numeric scale with tick values) — use single_axis_line_chart or one of the dual-y families instead
A bar chart — bars, not lines or connected markers, are not currently extractable
A pie or donut chart — not currently extractable
a chart whose data series are all the same color and distinguished only by marker shape or line style, not color — not currently extractable
output_requirements: The CMSL method traces this family from pixels before table conversion. Return plot frame and bottom/left/right axis geometry when visible. For bottom ticks, return each category label and its actual tick_position_px; keep label_numeric_value null for category labels. Return numeric y ticks and legend_items. Do not invent unreadable geometry; record an issue so Codex table-reading fallback can be used.

required_visual_features: A scientific line chart with two distinct, differently-scaled y axes (left and right), for a pair of quantities other than the current-voltage-power combination.
Legend or color coding that indicates which axis each curve maps to.
The curves are drawn in distinguishable colors, not just black lines told apart by marker shape or line style.
negative_cues: Marker-only scatter chart without visible connecting lines - not currently extractable
Current-voltage-power dual-y chart — use current_voltage_power_dual_y instead
Nyquist or impedance semicircle plot
bar chart
histogram
pie chart
a chart whose x axis positions are category labels rather than numbers — use categorical_line_chart instead
a chart whose data series are all the same color and distinguished only by marker shape or line style, not color — not currently extractable
output_requirements: Return bottom, left, and right axis geometry and numeric tick labels when visible.

For each legend item, set axis_binding_hint to left_y or right_y by matching the legend label's meaning to the corresponding axis title. This chart family relies on that hint, since curve shape alone cannot tell the two axes apart here — leave it null only when you truly cannot tell.
